title: Finiteness of a protocol's leaf rectangles
statement: For any deterministic two-party communication protocol $p$ over input types $X$ (Alice) and $Y$ (Bob) producing values in $\alpha$, the collection of leaf rectangles of $p$ — the input rectangles in $X \times Y$ induced by the leaves of $p$ over the full input space — is finite.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol over X, Y, alpha
replaced: For any protocol $p$, the set $\texttt{leafRectangles}(p)$ is finite.
